sections.Profile:
"Leap-Year," released by Marvel Manufacturing Company in April 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine featuring a festive theme. The playfield is equipped with four flippers, 13 passive bumpers, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Marvel Manufacturing Company
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Boats, Single Player, Vacation, Women, Wood Rail, Swimming, Original Theme
